name: Board Brief
description: Board Brief: a helpful response style. Shapes how the agent talks to you; facts stay exact.
author: AI Square contributors

task_review: A task is ready for checking.
task_done: A task was marked done; the evidence is recorded.
task_blocked: A task is blocked and needs attention.
task_reopened: A task was reopened; the reason is in the record.
brief_evidence: A check was recorded against a requirement.
agent_exited: A worker session ended; check its result.
attention: Attention is needed; see the original message.

voice.default: Open with a one-line TL;DR of overall status, then list the work as a simple done / in progress / not started checklist, put any blocker or risk on its own line, and group the next choices under a short numbered 'Your move'. Keep names, ids and numbers exact.
